dverse — declarative Dataverse plugin deployment

usage:
  dverse auth login  [--env <name>]             interactive device-code sign-in
  dverse auth logout [--env <name> | --all]     remove the persisted sign-in for the org (or all orgs)
  dverse auth list                              show persisted sign-ins (org + account)
  dverse whoami      [--env <name>]             verify connection; print user and org
  dverse model sync --entities a,b [--env <name>]   refresh dataverse.snapshot.json from metadata
  dverse plan  [--json] [--no-prune] [--no-build] [--assembly <dll>] [--package [--package-id <id>]] [--env <name>]
               without --assembly: finds the plugin project at/below the current directory and builds it first
                                             diff desired vs live registration (exit 0 = clean, 2 = changes)
  dverse apply [--no-prune] [--no-build] [--no-batch] [--assembly <dll>] [--package [--package-id <id>]] [--env <name>]
                                             push assembly + registration to the environment
               --package: deploy as a plugin package (nupkg with dependent assemblies); id defaults to the assembly name
               --no-batch: one request per write instead of parallel $batch changesets
  dverse adopt --assembly <name> [--env <name>] [--out <file.cs>] [--namespace <ns>] [--force]
                                             scaffold [Step] attributes from a live assembly's registration,
                                             Ids pinned (read-only; default prints to stdout)
  dverse webresources pull [--env <name>] [--set <path>] [--force]
                                             download each configured set's environment web resources into its
                                             local path (read-only; --force overwrites differing local files;
                                             nonconforming names get a ready-to-paste 'map:' snippet)
